cases.name: Debra Lynn Bates Wright
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a 1968 graduate of Campbell High School. She was also a graduate of Berry College with an Associate’s Degree and a graduate of Peabody College with a Bachelor’s Degree; then she continued with graduating from North Georgia College with her Master’s Degree. She was a retired High School teacher from the Monroe area. She also taught in the Barrow and Gwinnett County School Systems and the Buford City School System. Mrs. Wright was a member of the First Baptist Church of Tucker, GA where she was also a member of the Choral Group. She enjoyed singing and traveling. She also loved the arts and she loved dogs. She was a devoted mother, grandmother, aunt and had a host of friends. She was a Breast Cancer Survivor and she was always the Life of the Party!"
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative: Police found her deceased inside her vehicle in her driveway with a gunshot wound. The driver’s side window was also broken “by a projectile.” The officer spoke to a next-door neighbor, who told the officer that he came home an hour earlier and noticed the car parked in the driveway and thought it was strange the driver’s side window was broken. The neighbor walked to the vehicle and saw his neighbor had been wounded. He then called police.
